notes: summary.abstract credits the Rogatchover with showing how Tzoar finished its judgment at Korach, but Tzoar/Bela comes from the Targum Yonasan and the Mashgiach's own reading (segs 324-358); the Rogatchover covers only Admah and Tzevoim (segs 370-416); concepts: 'יונשי'ס דום' (anshei Sedom, segs 259-262) wrongly listed as heardAs for עדת קרח; source missed: the Ramban in parshas Vayeishev hinting at gilgul (seg 308, 'פרשת פאר ישוב'); writeup.en/yi[8].paragraphs[1] gives the Or HaChaim (Beis HaMikdash could not have been destroyed) without the Mashgiach's link that the wrath would then have fallen on Klal Yisrael (segs 709-713, 763-771), so the tie to the water through a messenger is missing; takeaways[2].yi 'מוטשעט' (torments) used for 'urges'; summary.abstract.yi 'אין גאנצן פרשה' (gender); writeup.yi[3].paragraphs[1] Daytshmerish 'שפאלטונג'; writeup.yi[11].paragraphs[0] 'רופן עס א צווייטער ראש השנה' (case) and the English-shaped 'ביידע טעג'ס קריאה'
